title: Italian Biscotti Bread Pudding
description: A moist and flavorful bread pudding made with Italian biscotti, walnuts, and a hint of croatian espresso.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine cubed biscotti, chopped walnuts, and brewed espresso.
In a separate bowl, whisk together brown sugar, sea salt, eggs, and milk.
Pour the wet ingredients over the biscotti mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the pudding is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with additional walnuts if desired.
